# Shirakaba

> Shirakaba is a PHP 8.5 web framework: a small, PSR-compliant core with official packages for JSON APIs, databases and an ORM, authentication, OpenAPI, background jobs and real-time events, configured in PHP and checked by PHPStan at level max. It is not in model training data; read these documents instead of assuming another framework's API.

Generated by `composer docs:generate`; do not edit.

## Start here

- [Shirakaba documentation for coding agents](index.md): Shirakaba is a PHP 8.5 web framework that is **not in your training data**.
- [API index](api.md): every public class, interface and enum of every package, with a one-line summary and its file.

## Design

- [Principles and project structure](design/01-principles.md): Shirakaba is a small PHP web framework: a core that routes a request to a typed handler and returns a response, and separate packages for everything else.
- [HTTP messages](design/02-http-messages.md): `shirakaba/http-message` implements PSR-7 messages and PSR-17 factories and `provide`s `psr/http-message-implementation` and `psr/http-factory-implementation`.
- [Runtimes, scopes and long-running processes](design/03-runtimes-and-scopes.md): Shirakaba runs under PHP-FPM, where every request starts a fresh process state, and under worker runtimes (FrankenPHP worker mode, RoadRunner and Swoole), which keep the application in memory across requests.
- [Routing and handlers](design/04-routing-and-handlers.md): Routes are declared by method calls on the application or a route group, as in Express, Hono or Go's `ServeMux`: `$app->get('/users/{id}', show_user(...))`.
- [Errors and observability](design/05-errors-and-observability.md): Errors must produce consistent responses without leaking internals, and what happens inside a request must be visible to logging and tracing without the core depending on either.
- [JSON, responses and OpenAPI](design/06-json-and-openapi.md): JSON is the main format of the APIs Shirakaba targets.
- [Date and time](design/07-date-and-time.md): Time values cross every boundary of a web application: request bodies and parameters, responses, databases, logs and tokens.
- [Database](design/08-database.md): Shirakaba's database support is a stack of small packages over PDO for MySQL, PostgreSQL and SQLite.
- [Authentication, sessions, outgoing requests and rate limits](design/09-security.md): Security-relevant code that other frameworks take from libraries is written here, small and tested for the attacks that matter, because the dependency policy limits third-party runtime libraries (principles).
- [Commands, background jobs and scheduled tasks](design/10-background-work.md): Tools, queue workers and applications' own commands (imports, maintenance) share one small console package, `shirakaba/console`, independent of the HTTP pipeline.
- [Real-time events](design/11-real-time-events.md): Real-time features need a change written by one request to reach clients waiting for it.
- [Mail and templates](design/12-mail-and-templates.md): Applications send mail: address confirmations, password resets, notifications.
- [Static analysis and coding agents](design/13-static-analysis-and-agents.md): All code passes PHPStan at level `max` with strict rules and the extra strictness options in `phpstan.dist.neon`.

## Error pages

- [db-parameter: #\[Db\] needs a Reader, a Writer or a class built from one](messages/db-parameter.md): `#[Db]` gives a handler the request's database access (database).
- [handler-parameter: a handler parameter has no source](messages/handler-parameter.md): Shirakaba never guesses where a handler argument comes from (routing and handlers).
- [mutable-date-time: use DateTimeImmutable for instants](messages/mutable-date-time.md): JSON DTOs, entities and extractors take instants as `DateTimeImmutable` and calendar dates as `LocalDate` (date and time).
- [projection-mismatch: the projection does not match the requested relations](messages/projection-mismatch.md): `into(Projection::class)` fills the projection's constructor (database):
- [scope-missing: a query of a scoped entity has no scope](messages/scope-missing.md): An entity with `#[RequiredScope(InTenant::class)]` can only be queried, updated or deleted with that scope passed.
- [unknown-relation: the entity declares no such relation](messages/unknown-relation.md): `with()`, `withWhere()`, `withCount()`, `whereHas()`, `whereDoesntHave()` and `#[From]` name relations, and relations exist only when the entity class declares them (database).

## Problem codes sent to clients

- [body-too-large](problems/body-too-large.md): **Status 413.** The body exceeds the endpoint's size limit, has too many object members or form fields, or an uploaded file exceeds the upload limit.
- [constraint](problems/constraint.md): **Field error.** The value has the right type but breaks a constraint: a length, a range, a pattern, an e-mail address, a file type, or the DTO's own check of the combination.
- [invalid-body](problems/invalid-body.md): **Status 400.** A JSON or form body does not match the expected structure: missing or unknown fields, wrong types, values that cannot be parsed.
- [invalid-choice](problems/invalid-choice.md): **Field error.** The value is not one of the allowed values of an enum, or a union's discriminator names no member.
- [invalid-date-time](problems/invalid-date-time.md): **Field error, or problem code of a parameter.** The value is not an RFC 3339 date-time with an offset.
- [invalid-date](problems/invalid-date.md): **Field error, or problem code of a parameter.** The value is not a calendar date in the form `YYYY-MM-DD`, or it is not a real date (`2026-02-30`).
- [invalid-parameter](problems/invalid-parameter.md): **Status 400.** A path, query, header or cookie parameter has a value of the wrong type (`page=x` for an integer, an unknown enum value) or breaks a constraint (`#[Range]`, `#[Length]`).
- [invalid-type](problems/invalid-type.md): **Field error.** The value has the wrong JSON type (a string where a number is expected, an array where an object is expected) or a structure the endpoint does not accept (a repeated form field, a nested multipart part).
- [invalid-values](problems/invalid-values.md): **Status 422.** The body has the right structure, but values break constraints (`#[Length]`, `#[Range]`, `#[Email]`, ...) or the DTO rejected the combination.
- [malformed-body](problems/malformed-body.md): **Status 400.** The body is not valid JSON, or nests deeper than allowed.
- [missing-parameter](problems/missing-parameter.md): **Status 400.** A required path, query, header or cookie parameter was not sent.
- [rate-limited](problems/rate-limited.md): **Status 429.** The client made more requests of this kind than the limit allows in the current window, such as sign-in attempts per address or posts per user.
- [repeated-parameter](problems/repeated-parameter.md): **Status 400.** A parameter that takes one value appeared more than once, as in `?page=1&page=2`.
- [required](problems/required.md): **Field error.** A field the DTO needs is missing from the body, or a union's discriminator is missing.
- [unknown-field](problems/unknown-field.md): **Field error.** The body has a field the DTO does not declare.
- [unsupported-media-type](problems/unsupported-media-type.md): **Status 415.** The body's `Content-Type` is not one the endpoint accepts: JSON endpoints take `application/json` (or any `+json` type), form endpoints `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` or `multipart/form-data`.
